subject.title: PR #92231 fix incomplete — commitment marked 'sent' but never delivered (second case)

question: Should inferred commitments remain a supported core delivery workflow that must guarantee visible reminders, or is the retirement path the intended replacement for existing users?
rationale: The reporter's concrete failure needs a correctness fix if the workflow remains supported, but current public documentation describes retirement while the latest release material still presents scheduled commitment follow-ups; only maintainers can resolve that product and migration boundary.

options.title: Confirm supported delivery contract
options.body: Keep inferred commitments supported, isolate the second false-sent outcome, and repair state transitions with end-to-end proof.

options.title: Confirm retirement and migration
options.body: Treat scheduled tasks as the replacement, document the upgrade path, and ensure existing commitment records cannot silently appear delivered.

recommendation.title: Confirm retirement and migration
recommendation.body: Treat scheduled tasks as the replacement, document the upgrade path, and ensure existing commitment records cannot silently appear delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged prior repair and have the clearest demonstrated context for the heartbeat commitment-delivery path.
